sections.title: I. Circle the letter before the best answer to complete the passage. (1 p)
sections.introHtml:
We need calories or (1) ___________ to do the things every day. For example, when we walk to school or (2) ___________ a bike to school we spend a certain number of calories and even when we sleep, we also use them. But how many calories should we spend a day to stay in shape? It’s difficult (3) ___________ us to calculate. If people want to keep (4) ___________, they should remember that everyone should have between 1600 and 2500 calories a day.

We get calories from the food we eat. If we get too much food and don’t take part (5) ___________ any activities, we can get fat quickly. So besides studying, we should do some exercises, play sports or do the housework, such as cleaning the floor, cooking etc. Otherwise, if we don’t eat enough, we will be tired and weak.

sections.title: II. Read the passage and do the task as directed. (1 p)
sections.introHtml:
Community service is very important in social life. As you know, our social life has both rich and poor people. Therefore, it is necessary for us to take part in volunteer activities to help poor people and elderly people. We can help them in various ways. Firstly, it is easy for us to collect old clothes which we don’t need. Besides, we can join in volunteer activities to raise funds for the poor and the homeless in our country. Finally, we can spend time talking with older people, sharing with poor children. Through these activities, we can develop our leadership skills by organizing fund raising, providing food as well.

sections.title: II. Write a paragraph of 60 - 80 words about your favorite hobby (1.0 p)

questions.html:
You should include this information.

- Name of hobby.

- When you started the hobby.

- Who you share it with.

- To do this hobby, you have to...

- Benefits of the hobby
questions.referenceHtml:
Tổng điểm là 1,0 điểm

1. Format: (0.1 point for correct format). One paragraph only with the introduction, the body,
and the conclusion.

2. Content: (0.4 point): a provision of main ideas and details as appropriate to the main idea.

3. Language: (0.3 point): a variety of vocabulary and structures appropriate to the level of
secondary students.

4. Presentation: (0.2 point): Coherence, cohesion and style appropriate to the level of secondary students.
